Hi Oliver / Sarah —

Thanks for the error snippet — that 401 looks like a token formatting issue we see when the key is copied with trailing quotes or an extra prefix. A couple quick checks before the call:

1) Ensure the key is pasted without surrounding quotes (eg: key_abc123, not "key_abc123").
2) Confirm you’re using the correct header: Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY>.
3) If you’re testing from a curl one-liner, remove any exported env var that contains a newline.

I attached a tiny script snippet you can run locally to validate the key and issue one test generation. If the snippet fails, paste the exact curl command and I’ll replicate locally.

Attachments: sdk-setup-snippet.sh, integration-debug-log.txt

See you at 3pm PT.
